facts.text: The Plaza stands at the corner of Fifth Avenue and Central Park South.
facts.excerpt: The Plaza stands as a masterpiece of elegance at the corner of Fifth Avenue and Central Park South.
Since opening in 1907, our luxury hotel has become a landmark

facts.text: The hotel says it was the first hotel in New York to permit pets.
facts.excerpt: Yes, we were the first hotel in New York to permit pets!

facts.text: The Tower Room is on the 18th floor, overlooks Fifth Avenue and has a large round bed under an exposed brick turret ceiling.
facts.excerpt: Unique room on the 18th floor overlooking 5th Ave featuring a large round bed in a unique tower under a soaring, 23-foot exposed brick turret ceiling.

facts.text: The Eloise suite is themed in pink and white and comes with Eloise bedding, a tea set and Eloise and Weenie dolls.
facts.excerpt: Pink and white Eloise themed suite with Eloise Bedding & towels, Tea Set, Eloise & Weenie dolls.

facts.text: The Gatsby Suite is a junior suite with Art Deco decor, dome ceilings, antique mirrors and glass chandeliers.
facts.excerpt: Junior suite in dramatic Art Deco decor of the Jazz Age with dome ceilings, antique mirrors, and glass chandeliers.

facts.text: The Palm Court serves tea with a Palais des Thés tea collection, sandwiches and fine pastries.
facts.excerpt: Guests of The Palm Court delight in the tradition of tea with our extensive Palais des Thés tea collection, as well as sandwiches and fine pastries.

facts.text: The Palm Court has a stained-glass ceiling.
facts.excerpt: Here, history and elegance beautifully intertwine under the breathtaking stained-glass ceiling

facts.text: The Champagne Bar serves champagne, caviar and wines.
facts.excerpt: Celebrate by night with the finest champagne, caviar and wines at The Champagne Bar in NYC.

facts.text: The hotel has a 111SKIN SPA/CLINIC that offers skincare.
facts.excerpt: The 111SKIN SPA/CLINIC offers a transformative wellness experience that combines innovative science with luxury skincare.

facts.text: The Plaza does not currently have a swimming pool.
facts.excerpt: The Plaza does not currently house a swimming pool.

facts.text: The fitness center is on the 4th floor.
facts.excerpt: Our fitness center is located on the 4th floor.

facts.text: The hotel's parking facility is off-site.
facts.excerpt: The hotel's parking facility is off-site.

facts.text: Each child receives a Plaza Passport at check-in.
facts.excerpt: Each child receives their very own Plaza Passport upon check-in

facts.text: The hotel describes its Fifth Avenue location as close to Central Park, Bergdorf Goodman, Museum Mile and Carnegie Hall.
facts.excerpt: from Central Park strolls and shopping at Bergdorf Goodman to exploring Museum Mile and enjoying world-class performances at Carnegie Hall

facts.text: The Carnegie suite has a partial Central Park view.
facts.excerpt: Partial Central Park view, separate living room, guest powder room, and grand bathroom with separate shower.

facts.text: Plaza 1 King rooms have bathrooms with mosaic tiles and gold fixtures.
facts.excerpt: Includes spacious bathroom adorned with mosaic tiles and gold fixtures, with bathtub and separate shower.
